review_calculation: Initial unloaded peak-line step through ideal blocking bridge and RF1-C1-L1-C4 Pi network
limitations: Linear L1 is invalid once its quoted small-signal/10%-drop envelope is exceeded. This is an overvoltage flag, NOT a guaranteed upper bound.
No source impedance beyond RF1, no measured parasitics/MOV/nonlinear inductance/converter load.
Higher-voltage C1 alone does not prove retained C4, L1, U1, MOV or surge/fault adequacy.
Calculation is a read-only review finding, not an implemented fix, physical measurement or order/energization authorization.
